title: Architecture Alignment With Sparse Priors in Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.36883v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are increasingly popular because they deliver strong predictions on new datasets through in-context learning, without task-specific training or extensive tuning. Yet released TFMs differ simultaneously in their pretraining priors, architectures, and objectives, obscuring their respective inductive biases. We therefore examine one concrete capability: irrelevant-feature suppression. Across synthetic tasks and real-world datasets, adding null features causes substantially greater predictive degradation in the row-token model TabDPT, whereas the cell-token alternating-axis model TabPFN v2 and other TFMs remain comparatively stable. This gap motivates us to ask whether architecture contributes to irrelevant-feature suppression. Because released TFMs remain confounded by other design choices, we train streamlined row-token and alternating-axis transformers under identical sparse-to-dense linear priors. Exact B

translated_title: 表格基础模型中基于稀疏先验的架构对齐研究
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型日益流行，因为它们能够通过上下文学习在新数据集上提供强大的预测能力，而无需针对特定任务的训练或大量的调参。然而，已发布的表格基础模型在预训练先验、架构和训练目标上同时存在差异，模糊了它们各自的归纳偏置。因此，我们考察了一个具体的能力：无关特征抑制。在合成任务和真实世界数据集上，添加空特征会导致行标记模型TabDPT的预测性能大幅下降，而单元标记交替轴模型TabPFN v2及其他表格基础模型则保持相对稳定。这一差距促使我们思考架构本身是否有助于无关特征抑制。由于已发布的表格基础模型仍受其他设计选择的干扰，我们在相同的稀疏到稠密线性先验下训练了精简的行标记和交替轴Transformer模型。
tldr: 该论文通过在相同的稀疏先验下控制变量地训练行标记与交替轴Transformer，揭示了架构本身（尤其是单元标记交替轴设计）对表格基础模型无关特征抑制能力的贡献。
en_tdlr: By training streamlined row-token and alternating-axis transformers under identical sparse priors, this paper reveals that architecture itself—particularly the cell-token alternating-axis design—contributes to irrelevant-feature suppression in tabular foundation models.
